title: V11 Autonomy State
description: Schema for .autonomy-state — per-project autonomy level and grants. Field names match hooks/track-autonomy writes verbatim (Wave 3b alignment).

level.description: Autonomy level: A0=manual, A1=guided, A2=supervised, A3=trusted, A4=autonomous, A5=self-organizing

successful.description: Consecutive successful actions (for escalation tracking). Written by track-autonomy on every medium-risk success.

errors.description: Recent error count (for de-escalation). Written by track-autonomy on tool-use errors.

approved_categories.description: Pre-approved file categories for A1+ levels

grants.description: File pattern grants for A2+ levels, plus explicit A4/A5 grants from scripts/autonomy-grant

high_risk_history.description: Previously approved high-risk patterns for A4 auto-approval

recent_errors.description: Ring buffer of recent errors used by de-escalation rules

repaired_at.description: Set by scripts/repair-empty-state when 0-byte file was reseeded

repaired_reason.description: Repair provenance (e.g. '0-byte corruption — seeded from repair-empty-state')

pattern.description: File path pattern to match. Length capped at 100 to block ReDoS payloads (HS-002).

type.description: Pattern matching strategy. regex patterns with nested quantifiers like (x+)+ are rejected at runtime (HS-002).

level.description: Autonomy level this grant applies to (for explicit A4/A5 grants from scripts/autonomy-grant)
